notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent that has its toughness boosted by at least 1.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
